### We believe this recognition affirms our investments and evolutions towards building a culture of data driven finance and accounting.


EXL has been recognized as a Leader in all 4 categories in the ISG Provider Lens 2021 Digital Financial and Accounting Outsourcing Services Report in the categories of **Procure to Pay (P2P), Order to Cash (O2C), Record to Report (R2R), Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)**


The report also highlights the key strengths of EXL, particularly it's in higher-end Record to Report and FP&A offerings


It recognizes that with our data and insights driven strategy to support the CFO function in generating insights and increasing time-to-value, EXL has built one of the largest Finance Analytics teams


This reaffirms our commitment in providing a customer-centric operating model and industry-specific comprehensive portfolio of digital solutions through our proprietary digital transformation stack, EXL™ Digital Finance Suite which has helped enterprise clients to accelerate time-to-value


[View press release](https://www.exlservice.com/about/newsroom/exl-recognized-leader-isg-provider-lens-digital-finance-accounting-outsourcing)


"EXL’s proven domain expertise, strong vertical knowledge, robust finance and accounting services portfolio and array of propriety digital solutions have helped it to secure its position as a leader in the global F&A services market. Through continuous investments in data-driven value creation frameworks and cloud-native digital solutions, it has enabled clients to accelerate their F&A transformation journeys and benefit from innovation."


**Amar Changulani, Senior Lead Analyst, ISG**


"We are pleased with our recognition as a Leader in the ISG Provider LensTM Quadrant Report 2021 for Digital Finance & Accounting Outsourcing services. The ability to turn data into insights, and insights into outcomes is at the core of our F&A services. This recognition validates the data-led strategy we’re using to create value for our clients."


**Nikhil Anand, Head of Finance and Accounting Center of Excellence, EXL**
